yAnti vE pApakAriRaH । ye pApakAriRastAn vidDi pAtAlatale narake kowisamanvitAn ॥ 10 ॥ aTa saptakulaparvatAH kaTyante । mAhendraH । malayaH SuktimAn fzyamfkaH sahyaparvataH binDyaH pAriyAtraH । ityete BArate kulaparvatAH ॥ 11 ॥ narmadAsurasAfzikulyABImaraTIkfzRAveRIcandraBAgAtAmraparRI ityetAH sapta nadyaH gaNgAyamunAgodAvarItuNgaBadrAkAverIsarayUrityetA mahAnadyaH pApaDynaH ॥ 12 ॥ jambunAmnA ca viKyAtaM jambudvIpamidaM SuBam । lakzayojanavistIrRamidaM SrezWaM tu BAratam ॥ 13 ॥ akzadvIpAdipuRyA janapadAH nizkAmA ye svaDarmeRa narasiMhaM yajanti te tatra nivasanti aDikArakzayAt muktiM ca prApnuvanti ॥ 14 ॥ jambAdyAH svAdUdakAntAH sapta payoDayaHH । tataH parA hiraRmayI BUmiH । tato lokAlokaparvataH eza BUrlokaH ॥ 15 ॥ asyopari antarikzalokaH KecarARAM ramyastadUrDvaM svargalokaH ॥ 16 ॥ svargasTAnaM mahApuRyaM procyamAnaM niboDa me । BArate kftapuRyAnAM devAnAmapi cAlayam ॥ 17 ॥ maDye pfTivyAmadrIndro BAsvAn merurhiraRmayaH । yojanAnAM sahasrARi caturaSItimucCritaH ॥ 18 ॥ pravizwaH zoqaSADastAdDaraRyAM DaraRIDaraH । tAvatpramARA pfTivI pUrvvataSca samantataH ॥ 19 ॥ tasya SfNgatrayaM mUrDri svargo yatra pratizWitaH । nAnAdrumalatAkIrRaM nAnApuzpopaSoBitam ॥ 20 ॥ maDyamaM paScimaM pUrvvaM meroH SfNgARi trIRi vE । maDyamaM sPAwikaM SfNgaM vEdUryamaRikAmayam ॥ 21 ॥ indranIlamayaM pUrvvaM mARikyaM paScimaM smftam । yojanAnAM sahasrARi niyutAni caturdaSa ॥ 22 ॥ ucCritaM maDyamaM SfNgaM svargo yatra trivizwapaH । apraBAntaritaM SfNgaM mUrDni CatrAkftisTitam । pUrvvamuttaraSfNgARAM antaraM maDyamasya ca । trivizwapo nAkapfzWe hyapsarAH santi nirvftAH ॥ 24 ॥ Anando'Ta pramodaSca svargaSfNge tu maDyame । SvetaSca pOzwikaScEva upaSoBanamanmaTO ॥ 25 ॥ AhlAdaH svargarAjA vE svargaSfNge tu paScime । nirmamo nirahaNkAraH sOBAgyaScAtinirmmalaH ॥ 26 ॥ svargAScEva dbijaSrezWa ! pUrvvaSfNge samAsTitAH । ekaviMSAni svargA vE nivizwA merumUrdDani ॥ 27 ॥ ahiMsAdAnakartAro yajYAnAM tapasAM taTA । tattezu nivasanti sma janAH kroDavivarjitAH ॥ 28 ॥ jalapraveSe cAnandaM pramodaM vahnisAhase । BfguprapAte sOKyaM ca raRaM cEvAsya nirmalam ॥ 29 ॥ anASake tu saMnyAse mfto gacCettrivizwapam । kratuyAjI nAkapfzWaM agnihotrI ca nirvftim ॥ 30 ॥ taqAgakUpakarttA ca laBate pOzwikaM dvijaH । suvarRadAyI sOBAgyaM laBan svargatapaHPalam ॥ 31 ॥ SItakAle mahAvahniM prajvAlayati yo naraH । sarvvasattvahitArTAya svargaM sopsarasaM laBet ॥ 32 ॥ hiraRyagopradAne hi nirahaNkAramApnuyAt । BUmidAnena SudDena laBate SAntikaM padam ॥ 33 ॥ rOpyadAnena svargaM tu nirmalaM laBate naraH । aSvadAnena puRyAhaM kanyAdAnena maNgalam ॥ 34 ॥ dvijeByastarpaRaM kftvA datvA vastrARi BaktitaH । SvetaM tu laBate svargaM yatra gatvA na Socate ॥ 35 ॥ kapilAgopradAnena paramArTe mahIyate । govfzasya pradAnena svargaM manmaTamApnuyAt ॥ 36 ॥ mADamAse saritsnAyI tilaDenupradastaTA ॥ CatropAnahadAtA ca svargaM yAtyupaSoBanam ॥ 37 ॥ devatAyatanaM kftvA dvijaSuSrUzakastaTA । tIrTayAtrAparaScEva svargarAjye mahIyate ॥ 38 ॥ ekAnnaBojI yo martyo naktaBojI ca nityaSaH । upavAsI trirAtrAdyEH SAntaH svargaM SuBaM laBet ॥ 29 ॥ saritsnAyI jitakroDo brahmacArI dfQavrataH । nirmalaM svargamApnoti yaTABUtahite ratAH ॥ 40 ॥ vidyAdAnena meDAvI nirahaNkAramApnuyAt । yena yena hi BAvena yadyaddAnaM prayacCati ॥ 41 ॥ tattatsvargamavApnoti yadyadicCati mAnavaH । catvAri atidAnAni kanyA gOrBUH saraKatI ॥ 42 ॥ narakAdudDarantyete japavAhanadohanAt । yastu sarvvARi dAnAni brAhmaReByaH prayacCati ॥ 43 ॥ saMprApya na nivartteta svargaM SAntamanAmayam । SfNge tu paScime yatra brahmA tatra sTitaH svayam ॥ 44 ॥ pUrvvaSfNge svayaM vizRuH maDye cEva SivaH sTitaH । ataH paraM tu viprendra ! svargADvAnamimaM SfRu ॥ 45 ॥ vimalaM vipulaM SudDamuparyyuparisaMsTitam । praTame tu kumArastu dbitIye mAtaraH sTitAH ॥ 46 ॥ tftIye sidDaganDarvA turyye vidyADarA dbija ! paYcame nAgarAjA ca zazWe tu vinatAsutaH ॥ 47 ॥ saptame divyapitaro DarmmarAjastaTAzwame । navame tu taTA dakza Adityo daSame paTi ॥ 48 ॥ BUrlokAcCatasAhasrAdUrdDvaM carati BAskaraH । yojanAnAM sahasre dbe vizwamBanasamaM tataH ॥ 49 ॥ triguRaM pariRAhena sUryyabimbaM pramARataH । somapuryyAM viBAvaryyAM maDyAhne cAryyamA yadA । mahendrasyAmarAvatyAM tadA tizWati BAskaraH ॥ 50 ॥ maDyAhne tvamarAvatyAM yadA Bavati BAskaraH । tadA saMyamane yAmye tatrodyaMstu pradfSyate ॥ 51 ॥ meruM pradakziRaM kurvvan BAtyeva savitA sadA । DruvADArastaTottizWan vAliKilyAdiBiH stutaH ॥ 52 ॥ iti SrInarasiMhapurARe BUvanakoSe triMSoDyAyaH ॥ 30 ॥)
